Implement GitHub issue #613: self-serve seat upgrade UI.

## Repository
`/Users/jobinlawrance/Project/raven` — Vue.js 3 frontend in `frontend/` directory.

## What to build
A UI on the billing dashboard (`/orgs/:orgId/billing`) that lets an admin increase their seat count mid-cycle. The backend endpoint already exists: `PATCH /api/v1/billing/subscriptions/:id/seats` accepts `{ seat_count: N }` and returns a `PaymentIntent` with `client_secret`. The user completes the prorated charge via Hyperswitch's embedded payment element; on payment success the webhook updates `seat_count`.

## Read these files first
- `frontend/src/pages/billing/BillingPage.vue` — where the "Upgrade seats" button goes
- `frontend/src/pages/billing/CheckoutPage.vue` — reference for Hyperswitch SDK initialisation pattern (CDN load, `Hyper(publishableKey)`, `elements.create('payment')`, mount on `#payment-element`)
- `frontend/src/api/billing.ts` — extend with new function
- `frontend/src/stores/billing.ts` — use existing store actions like `fetchSubscription` after success
- `internal/handler/billing.go` — backend endpoint contract for reference
- `internal/model/billing.go` — `UpdateSeatCountRequest` and `PaymentIntent` types

## Heads-up about parallel work
Two other agents are working concurrently on the same area:
- #614 adds a "Compare plans" link/page touching BillingPage.vue and `frontend/src/api/billing.ts` (extends `Plan` interface)
- #615 refactors CheckoutPage.vue to use `getPlans()` instead of hardcoded constants

You may rebase later. Keep your changes scoped to: BillingPage upgrade button + modal/panel, a new composable if you extract Hyperswitch init, `api/billing.ts` `updateSeatCount()` function. Do NOT modify CheckoutPage.vue or the Plan interface.

## Acceptance criteria (from issue)
- [ ] "Upgrade seats" button visible on BillingPage when status is `active` or `trialing`
- [ ] Seat input rejects values ≤ current seat count and < Plan.MinSeats client-side
- [ ] Calls `PATCH /api/v1/billing/subscriptions/:id/seats` and receives client_secret
- [ ] Reuses the same Hyperswitch SDK initialisation pattern as CheckoutPage
- [ ] Payment success path refreshes the subscription via `store.fetchSubscription()`
- [ ] Payment failure path shows inline error without unmounting the form
- [ ] Loading and error states on the API call
- [ ] Accessible: keyboard-navigable, ARIA labels on input + buttons

## Implementation notes
- Add `updateSeatCount(subscriptionId: string, seatCount: number): Promise<PaymentIntent>` to `frontend/src/api/billing.ts` (define a `PaymentIntent` interface mirroring backend response: `{ id, client_secret, amount, currency, status }`)
- Don't add a new route — keep the upgrade flow inside BillingPage as a modal or expandable panel
- Hyperswitch SDK loader pattern from CheckoutPage:
  - Load `https://beta.hyperswitch.io/v1/HyperLoader.js` dynamically (only once globally)
  - `const hyper = Hyper(import.meta.env.VITE_HYPERSWITCH_PUBLISHABLE_KEY)`
  - `const elements = hyper.elements({ clientSecret })`
  - `const paymentElement = elements.create('payment'); paymentElement.mount('#payment-element-seats')` — use a different DOM id than CheckoutPage to avoid collision
- Show the prorated amount returned from the API in the UI before the payment element renders (so the user knows what they're being charged)

## Commit rules
- Sign every commit: `git commit -s -m "..."` (DCO required)
- No AI attribution (no Co-Authored-By)
- Branch name: `feat/billing-seat-upgrade-ui`
- Create a PR: `gh pr create --base main --title "feat(billing): self-serve seat upgrade UI (#613)" --body "..."`
- After PR is created, queue for auto-merge: `gh pr merge <N> --auto --squash`

## Notes
- Follow existing patterns: `<script setup lang="ts">`, Composition API, Tailwind v4 dark slate theme, `useMobile` composable if you need responsive behavior, BottomSheet for mobile if the upgrade panel should slide up
- Don't start dev server — write code and commit

input.prompt:
Implement GitHub issue #615: refactor CheckoutPage to source plan + price from `getPlans()` instead of hardcoded constants.

## Repository
`/Users/jobinlawrance/Project/raven` — Vue.js 3 frontend in `frontend/` directory.

## Problem
`frontend/src/pages/billing/CheckoutPage.vue` hardcodes:
```ts
const PRO_PLAN_ID = 'plan_pro'
const MIN_SEATS = 5
const PRICE_PER_SEAT_PAISE = 170_000
const ANNUAL_MONTHS = 10
```
If backend pricing changes, the UI displays stale data and the displayed total disagrees with what Hyperswitch actually charges. The component already calls `getPlans()` on mount (line 185) but barely uses the response.

## Read these files first
- `frontend/src/pages/billing/CheckoutPage.vue` — the file to refactor
- `frontend/src/api/billing.ts` — `getPlans()` and the `Plan` interface
- `internal/model/billing.go` — backend Plan struct (`PricePerSeatMonthly`, `MinSeats`, `Tier`, `ID`)
- `internal/handler/billing.go` — `GetPlans` handler

## Heads-up about parallel work
Two other agents are working concurrently:
